-- Phase 1: spec for a seed-determined shuffle. No capabilities are granted.

-- One step of a linear congruential generator, kept in 31 bits so the
-- multiplication stays inside checked 64-bit range.
step(seed: int) -> int =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out < 2147483648
  ex step(0) == 12345
  (1103515245 * (seed % 2147483648) + 12345) % 2147483648

-- A pseudo-random index in [0, n).
pick(seed: int, n: int) -> int =
  pre n > 0
  post out >= 0
  post out < n
  ex pick(5, 1) == 0
  step(seed) % n

-- The elements of xs in a shuffled order determined only by seed.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 0) == []
  ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
  var res = copy xs
  var s = seed
  var i = res.len() - 1
  while i > 0
    let j = pick(s, i + 1)
    let t = res[i]
    res[i] = res[j]
    res[j] = t
    s = step(s)
    i -= 1
  res
